In celebration of Goosemas XII, I’ll be collecting all previous Goosemas posters in a series of posts for you to enjoy!

GOOSEMAS I

12/20/14 at the Factory Underground Studio in Norwalk, CT

Goosemas I had no known poster. But supposedly Coach provided pizza and beer kegs, Goose played three sets, and the Goosemas at the Factory tradition was born!

GOOSEMAS II 

12/19/15 at the Factory Underground Studio in Norwalk, CT

Oldest Goose poster I can find. Incomplete setlist, but supposedly “Gringo” and “Carol of the Bells” were played.

GOOSEMAS III 

12/23/16 at the Factory Underground Studio in Norwalk, CT

No known setlist for this Goosemas!

GOOSEMAS IV

12/23/17 at the Factory Underground Studio in Norwalk, CT

Handini’s (Pete Anspach’s) first show as an official member of Goose.

GOOSEMAS V

12/22/18 at Cantiki SoNo in Norwalk, CT

FTP for “White Lights,” a personal favorite. Must’ve brought down the house because Cantiki SoNo has since closed.

GOOSEMAS VI

12/21/19 at the Wall Street Theater in Norwalk, CT

Theme show! First set was Ghost of Goosemas Past and the second was Ghost of Goosemas Future. Features a canned food drive and the FTP of “Honeybee.”

GOOSEMAS VII

12/11/20 at the Rockefeller Center Loft and Garden (rooftop show) in New York, NY

First Goosemas outside Norwalk and first to be live streamed. COVID didn’t slow Goose down and Goosemas VII was the icing on the cake. My personal first Goosemas. Insane version of “You and Whose Army.”

GOOSEMAS VIII

2/26/22 at the Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, CT. 

Originally scheduled for 12/18/21 at the Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, CT. This date was canceled due to a COVID case in the touring crew.

Goose’s biggest headlining show to date! Spud (Ben Atkind) proposed to his girlfriend during the show. FTP for “Dripfield” and “Hungersite.”

GOOSEMAS IX

12/16-17/22 at the 1STBANK Center in Broomfield, CO

First two-day Goosemas celebration. For the second set on both nights, ping pong balls with fan requests determined the set lists.

GOOSEMAS XI

12/13-14/24 at the North Charleston Coliseum and Performing Arts Center in Charleston, SC

Bingo night! Both nights’ setlists were randomly determined by drawing bingo balls. Premier of the famous D&BFlamingos song where Snakes (Rick Mitarotonda) and Handini crowdsurfed on inflatable flamingos 🦩.
